literal_meaning: লাগা এবং চলে যাওয়া (to attach and proceed)
figurative_meaning_en: to take effect, to stick or work out well
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার উপদেশটা আমার মনে লেগে গেছে।
ঔষধটা লেগে গেছে, এখন সুস্থ হয়ে উঠব।
example_sentences_in_english: His advice has stuck with me.
The medicine has taken effect; I'll recover soon.
note: Common in everyday Bengali speech for describing something that resonates or becomes effective.
